_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no frozen family API contract exists (see lib/api-client/family.ts)
note: The family's own records for the four screens that wait on a family-facing service: Requests (crm-cases.md » Customer service ticketing, blueprint §40), Appointments (facilities-scheduling.md » Appointment & scheduling engine, blueprint §35), the lot record (memorial-property-gis.md » Lot record + sales/ownership, blueprint §15/§19) and the memorial record (06-cultural-digital-memorial/digital-memorial.md » Villa eMemorial page, blueprint §22).

WHAT THIS IS: app-authored UI records, the same pattern as lib/fixtures/agent/workspace.json. No service desk, no family scheduling read/write contract, no family-facing lot/ownership projection and no digital-memorial service exists, so every screen that reads this file ends in one calm note naming the missing contract, and the office phone stays the action that reaches a person. Nothing here is a live record.

THE HOUSEHOLD SHAPE (captain, 2026-09-30): one account manages MANY loved ones, so `loved_ones[]` keys the lot, the requests and the appointments per person — the same records each screen already read, now addressed by `id` (the same id as lib/fixtures/family/snapshot.json and case.json, pinned by tests/fixture-contract/family-workspace.test.ts). `ask_for` stays household-level: the office's request taxonomy is the same for every person.

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/family-workspace.test.ts): each `lot.plan_name` and `lot.owner_name` are the loved one's own words in lib/fixtures/family/snapshot.json, `lot.park`/appointment `where` wording comes from lib/family/contact.ts and the park masterplan's own POIs (lib/park-3d/masterplan.ts), the request kinds mirror crm-cases.md:44 (lot concern · payment · maintenance · document request · transfer · interment · memorial update · chapel/funeral inquiry · other), and the appointment reasons are the PRD's seven (facilities-scheduling.md:35).

NEVER INVENTED: no chapel is named (the park's chapel list is still a PLACEHOLDER in staff scheduling — scheduling/chapel-admin.json), no amount and no currency appears in this file (money lives in the family snapshot and lib/villa-pricing.ts), no ticket number exists (the office writes a request down; the app does not issue one), no coordinator is named, and nothing about a loved one is published — the memorial page is a state, not content.
Appointment `starts_at` values are true instants: rendering them through lib/family/family-view.ts must reproduce the fixture's own `day_label`/`time_label` (Asia/Manila).

ask_for.detail: A correction, a name, a photo, or a message when the memorial opens.

ask_for.detail: Times, rooms, a mass, or any question about the arrangement.

ask_for.detail: Tell us in your own words — we would rather hear it than not.
